title: Jurassic Park Ride
content: I constantly have dreams in an amusement park or mall/amusement park. IRL when I was younger I was too small to go on the Jurassic park ride at universal and now I have dreams where I’m with a group and it’s a goal to go on the ride but we keep getting side tracked and never do it. It almost seems like unfulfilled desires but I was also probably too scared to go on it if I was tall enough when I was younger.
